# Approve a reserved corporate matter

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

Before a transaction or action that may require board, stockholder, investor or lender consent. A decision record proving which approvals were obtained and which conditions remain before execution.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Describe the proposed action and commitments

agent-runnable


Prepare the transaction terms, financial exposure, counterparties and intended timing. Identify related documents and previously granted delegations without assuming ordinary purchasing authority covers the action.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Identify the required decision makers

human · human approval required


Have counsel check governing documents, shareholder agreements, financing covenants and applicable rules. Record approval thresholds, conflicts and any notice or meeting requirements for the actual matter.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Assemble the decision materials

agent-runnable


Draft a clear recommendation, alternatives, risks, supporting calculations and proposed resolutions. Keep unresolved terms visible and provide the same final version to the authorized reviewers.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Obtain and record the approvals

human · human approval required


Run the agreed meeting or written-consent process with the required participants. Record recusals, conditions and executed decisions; a favorable discussion alone does not authorize the transaction.

- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Verify conditions before the execution handoff

agent-runnable


Reconcile each approval with the final transaction and confirm it remains within the approved scope. Hand the evidence to the authorized executor and retain an exception log for changes requiring another decision.

- Verify: A decision record proving which approvals were obtained and which conditions remain before execution.
- Sources: [GOV.UK running a limited company](https://www.gov.uk/running-a-limited-company)
